title: FASCIST-O-METER: Classifier for Neo-fascist Discourse Online

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating the ability of Small Language Models (SLMs) and Large Language Models (LLMs) to detect and classify neo-fascist extremist discourse online using a custom annotated dataset and a political science-based coding scheme.

Conducting qualitative error analysis on model predictions to identify if the classifiers developed an unintended predictive bias, which revealed a slight bias toward associating the word 'white' with neo-fascist labels.
